claims.text: Ashcombe Foods seeks support to transform its finance function following three acquisitions.
The transformation aims to shorten the month‑end close cycle and standardise reporting across legal entities.
It also aims to release working capital through revised payment terms and an updated inventory policy.
Finally, a controls‑first close calendar will be designed and the finance team retrained on the new processes.
VCG follows a four‑phase delivery methodology: Diagnose, Design, Deliver, and Sustain.
A joint steering committee governs every engagement and meets fortnightly.
For engagements longer than six months, VCG assigns a dedicated Engagement Quality Director independent of the delivery team.
Knowledge‑transfer workshops are conducted in the final four weeks of each engagement to embed new processes.
In an eight‑month engagement for Calder Foods, VCG reduced the month‑end close from 12 days to 6 days and standardised 41 reporting templates across three legal entities.
The Calder Foods project also introduced a controls‑first close calendar and retrained 55 finance staff on the new process.
VCG released 180 Cr of working capital for Voss Retail over 12 months by resetting DPO and DSO and redesigning inventory policy across six categories.
The Voss Retail engagement renegotiated payment terms with 140 suppliers to achieve the working‑capital release.
VCG has delivered 340 engagements since 2020 with a client repeat‑engagement rate of 68 percent, demonstrating strong client satisfaction.
VCG’s proven four‑phase methodology and rigorous governance structure position us to meet Ashcombe Foods’ objectives efficiently.
Our track record of halving month‑end close times and standardising reporting, as shown at Calder Foods, directly aligns with the desired outcomes.
The ability to release large volumes of working capital, evidenced by the 180 Cr release for Voss Retail, demonstrates our capability to optimise cash flow for Ashcombe Foods.
With a 68 percent repeat‑engagement rate and an average team size of seven consultants, VCG combines experience and dedicated resources to ensure successful delivery.
